title: MemeCoinSnipeFrame
tagline: We enable meme coin sniping through farcaster, so buying meme coin can be more accessible to farcaster users.
description: The MemeCoinSnipeFrame initiative, crafted by a focused team, tackles the burgeoning activity in the memecoin sector on the base chain through a bespoke frame on Farcaster. This innovative frame updates hourly to spotlight the latest memecoins, providing critical information such as the coin's name, symbol, total supply, and details about the deployer. It also includes direct access to platforms like DexScreener, BaseScan, and Uniswap for in-depth research and immediate trading. Additionally, a community-led verification feature allows users to flag suspect memecoins, thus promoting a safer investment landscape. In essence, MemeCoinSnipeFrame seeks to evolve the current Farcaster frame landscape from a predominantly NFT-focused interface to a comprehensive and secure memecoin trading platform, aiming to improve the overall trading ecosystem.
how_its_made: Our frame server was developed using Next.js, while the backend server utilizes Python FastAPI. We focus on aggregating memecoins on the Base chain, leveraging the developer-friendly infrastructure it offers. This allows us to efficiently identify and curate newly created memecoins on Base, making them readily accessible to users on Farcaster. Thanks to Base's supportive ecosystem, our process of detecting and presenting fresh memecoins has been greatly streamlined.
